svg.title: Campus docent story policy on a scripted visit
svg.desc: A visitor enters the museum, asks for stories, asks again, moves to the RCA 1802 exhibit, asks about APL glyphs, and clears the context; each row shows which canned story the policy selects and how many stories of the current place remain untold.
svg.text: STORY POLICY -- which story, when, and never twice unless asked
WHAT: stories are canned text per place; the model only signals that a story is wanted; a deterministic policy picks it.
ask: another story (place exhausted, ancestor used)
ask: tell me that again (repeat only on request)
arrive at rca-1802 again (arrival is told once)
ask about glyphs, model predicts destination apl
ask: tell me more (no destination, current place)
clear the docent context (told stories forgotten)
Told after step 8: 6 stories; the told record is a string of ids (|a|b|) kept in the browser's docent context.
WHY: docents tell stories, and canned stories cannot hallucinate; the tiny model decides that a story is wanted and
which concepts fit, while the policy chooses among real text so the same visitor never hears one twice by accident.
HOW: u:story_pick prefers an untold story of the predicted destination matching the concept, then any untold one there,
then the current place, then its ancestors; u:story_arrival volunteers an arrival story once; again repeats the last.
HOW: u:told_mark appends to the told record; u:story_remaining counts what is left so the easel can offer another.
tests/test_campus.mlpl runs this visit and asserts every selection, including the empty pick when nothing untold fits.
